package.name: SafetyNet
package.description: The work kept safe with no one at the computer: checkpoints as saved copies of a document, auto-save copies, documents back after a crash or a hang, FreeCAD's settings logged and rolled back, and macros that run only once the person approved them. Plain FreeCAD; tools for agents through Agent Link for FreeCAD when it is installed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project or the FPA.
